rationale: Two-line CSS class change in IntegrationSection.tsx fixing a visual regression from EPMCDME-10302. Blind lens: no logic changes, no state, no API surface — pure Tailwind class adjustments. Edge-case lens: showAddButton condition mirrors IntegrationSelectDropdown's render condition exactly (!isDropdownShown && !(isRequired && hasNoSettings)), so flex-1 is applied on the correct paths. ml-0 correctly overrides ml-auto via tailwind-merge v3 conflict resolution (confirmed by node -e test). h-8 (no !) correctly overrides h-7 via tailwind-merge v3. Acceptance lens: both buttons left-aligned and same height in the Add button path; Select path layout unchanged. No regressions: 416 unit test files (4 516 tests) and 36 integration files (479 tests) green.
